evidence.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-DSpark Draft Models That Deliver Up to 3.18x Faster Decoding Without Changing Model Outputs

summary: Liquid AI has released new LFM2.5-DSpark Draft models that accelerate decoding speeds by up to 3.18 times without altering model outputs. The update aims to improve efficiency in AI inference tasks.
title: Liquid AI Unveils LFM2.5-DSpark Models for 3.18x Faster AI Decoding
